description: The bar chart illustrates the accuracy of different sentence embedding methods, as measured by correlation with human judgment. The vertical axis represents accuracy, ranging from 0 to 0.6, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists the embedding methods: "Sentiment Acc.," "STS Corr.," "Paraphrase Acc.," "Unsupervised SimCSE," "Supervised SimCSE," and "2-Tier SimCSE." Each method is represented by a group of three bars in different colors: light blue for "Sentiment Acc.," pink for "STS Corr.," and teal for "Paraphrase Acc." The bars are not sorted in any specific order. The "Sentiment Acc." method shows the lowest accuracy, with a value just above 0.2, while the "2-Tier SimCSE" method shows the highest accuracy, with a value just below 0.6. The "STS Corr." and "Paraphrase Acc." methods have similar values, with the "STS Corr." method slightly higher than the "Paraphrase Acc." method. The chart does not contain any additional annotations or visual emphasis on the bars.
